draw_line_to_bronze_chests.label: Tracer des lignes vers les coffres en bronze
draw_line_to_bronze_chests.tooltip: Trace une ligne de la position de votre personnage vers les coffres en bronze proches, hors combat.

draw_line_to_silver_chests.label: Tracer des lignes vers les coffres en argent
draw_line_to_silver_chests.tooltip: Trace une ligne de la position de votre personnage vers les coffres en argent proches, hors combat.

show_hunt_button.label: Afficher le bouton de chasse au coffres

show_spirit_pot_prediction.label: Afficher la prediction du pot
show_spirit_pot_prediction.tooltip: Affiche la zone et les points candidats indiques par le pot sur la carte de North Horn

cast_treasure_sight_before_hunt.label: Utiliser Détection de trésors avant la chasse
cast_treasure_sight_before_hunt.tooltip: Descend de monture, passe en Freelancer, utilise Détection de trésors puis restaure le job précédent

treasure_sight_every_n_locations.label: Treasure Sight every N spots
treasure_sight_every_n_locations.tooltip: Recast Treasure Sight after checking this many coffer spots. 0 disables.

hunt_silver_chests_only.label: Silver coffers only
hunt_silver_chests_only.tooltip: Only route through silver coffer spots. North Horn route spots carry no coffer type, so this does nothing there.

skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.label: Wait out unsafe South Horn windows
skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.tooltip: During South Horn's night (ET 22:30 to 4:00) or dangerous weather, finish the current spot and wait until it is safe.

return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.label: Return to camp after the hunt
return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.tooltip: Return to base camp when the route is done or no coffers are left.

play_sound_on_hunt_complete.label: Sound when the hunt finishes
play_sound_on_hunt_complete.tooltip: Play a sound when the route is done or no coffers are left.

hunt_min_bronze_percent.label: Auto hunt: minimum bronze (%)
hunt_min_bronze_percent.tooltip: The hunt between activities starts once bronze coffers (out of 30) reach this share; bronze or silver is enough.

hunt_min_silver_percent.label: Auto hunt: minimum silver (%)
hunt_min_silver_percent.tooltip: The hunt between activities starts once silver coffers (out of 8) reach this share; with silver only, silver alone decides.

use_south_horn_authored_route.label: Use the authored South Horn route
use_south_horn_authored_route.tooltip: In South Horn, visit coffers in the hand-authored area order (base camp, Wanderer's Haven, Crystallized Caverns, Eldergrowth, Stonemarsh) instead of a freshly computed route. Pick the starting area in the hunt panel.

use_ninja_hide_on_dangerous_routes.label: Use Ninja Hide on dangerous routes
use_ninja_hide_on_dangerous_routes.tooltip: When a mob with high enough Knowledge is near a treasure hunt or pot coffer route, dismount, swap to your Ninja gearset and Hide past it, then drop Hide and swap back once clear. Haunts see through Hide and are ignored.

use_occult_sprint_while_hidden.label: Use Occult Sprint while hidden
use_occult_sprint_while_hidden.tooltip: While hidden, switch to Phantom Thief to use Occult Sprint; the previous phantom job is restored before opening a coffer.

ninja_gearset_number.label: Ninja gearset number
ninja_gearset_number.tooltip: The gearset to equip when Hide is needed (1-based, as in the game's gearset list). 0 never swaps, so Hide is only used if you are already a Ninja.

knowledge_hide_offset.label: Knowledge hide offset
knowledge_hide_offset.tooltip: Mobs at your Knowledge level plus this offset or higher count as threats. Raise it to hide only from stronger mobs.

knowledge_threat_enter_distance.label: Hide enter distance
knowledge_threat_enter_distance.tooltip: Hide when a threat comes this close; +5 yalms while mounted.

knowledge_threat_exit_distance.label: Hide exit distance
knowledge_threat_exit_distance.tooltip: Drop Hide once every threat has been beyond this distance for 2.5 seconds; remounting waits until 35 yalms clear.

hunt.title: Chasseur de coffres
hunt.map_missing: La carte de route est indisponible
hunt.spirit_pot_conflict: Le nouvel indice est incompatible ; les points precedents sont conserves

panel.title: Coffres
panel.detecting_detail: Le nombre de coffres apparaîtra après la première analyse en temps réel.
